> A list of 1,698 gene names is not a finding. Today you turn one into a
> sentence, and then check whether the sentence is real.

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)

source(here("R/count_tables.R"))

d <- read_counts("instructional")

# You need yesterday's preterm-versus-term gene results (notebook 04, Exercise 2,
# step 7). If you no longer have them, rerun the three lines from notebook 04.
# That is what a script is for.
```
